anyOf.description: Keyframes, sorted by time; before the first and after the last the value holds.

Animated.description: A value that is either constant or keyframed.

anyOf.description: Keyframes, sorted by time; before the first and after the last the value holds.

Animated2.description: A value that is either constant or keyframed.

Asset.description: A file the edit reads, addressed by content.

of.description: For a derived asset (a mask sequence, a stabilisation track), the asset it was made from.

probe.description: What the editor measured when it imported the file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex. This, not the URI, is the asset's identity.

uri.description:
Where to fetch it: `file:`, `https:`, `s3:`, `opfs:`… A renderer may resolve the hash
through its own cache instead.

oneOf.description: Video, possibly with sound.
A still image.
Sound only.
A font file.
Per-frame alpha masks derived from another asset.
A colour lookup table.

A Lottie animation (feature `lottie/1`): Bodymovin JSON or a dotLottie archive. It has
no frames of its own: any instant is drawn, at the size the asset's `probe` gives, and
past its length it goes round again. A media layer shows it as it shows a video.

asset.description: A `video` or `audio` asset. Empty when the clip plays a composition.

at.description: When it starts on the output timeline.

comp.description:
The composition whose mix it plays instead of an asset (feature `comp/1`), from
`time.source_in` at speed 1.

fx.description: What is done to the sound, in order, before its gain (feature `audio.fx/1`).

gain_db.description: Gain in dB; keyframe times are relative to the clip's start.

keep_pitch.description:
At a speed other than 1, stretch the sound in time keeping its pitch (feature
`audio.stretch/1`) instead of resampling it, which moves the pitch with the speed.

pitch.description:
Semitones the sound is moved up (negative: down) without changing how long it lasts
(feature `audio.pitch/1`). Sound played backwards ignores it.

oneOf.description: AAC-LC.
Opus.

AudioEffect.description:
One thing done to a clip's sound. Each is a function of the clip's own samples, counted from
its start (what came before the clip is silence), so a mix made in pieces matches one made
whole.

oneOf.description:
Steady background noise taken out. The sound is cut into frames of 1024 samples half a
frame apart; in each, what does not rise above the noise is turned down.

amount.description: How much is taken out, from 0 (nothing) to 1.

floor.description:
The noise: its power density in dB (full scale squared per hertz) in each of
[`AudioEffect::NOISE_BANDS`] bands evenly spaced on a log scale from 60 Hz to 16 kHz,
the first and last taking what lies beyond.

oneOf.description: Only what lies between two frequencies is kept, as through a telephone.

high.description: The highest frequency kept, in Hz.

low.description: The lowest frequency kept, in Hz.

oneOf.description: The sound multiplied by a sine wave (ring modulation): a robot's voice.

mix.description: How much of the result is the modulated sound, from 0 to 1.

oneOf.description: The sound again, later and quieter, a number of times.

decay.description: How loud each repeat is next to the one before, from 0 to 1.

Between.description: What a video layer shows at an instant between two of its file's frames.

oneOf.description: The frame of that instant, held until the next.

The two frames mixed, by how far along from the one to the other the instant is (feature
`frames.blend/1`).

A frame made in between (feature `frames.flow/1`): what moved from the one frame to the
other is followed, and drawn as far along its way as the instant is. Where nothing can
be followed, the two are mixed as for `blend`.
Over.
Sum.
Product.
Inverse product.
Multiply in the dark parts, screen in the bright (feature `blend/2`, as are those below).
The darker of the two.
The lighter of the two.
A gentle overlay.
Overlay, led by the layer.
The difference.
Brightens what is below.
Darkens what is below.

CharCurve.description: How a character travels between `pose` and rest.

oneOf.description: From `pose` to rest once, fast at first and slowing into place; its opacity in a straight line.
As `settle`, overshooting rest a little before it comes back.
To `pose`, back through rest to its opposite and back, every round.
To `pose` and back in the first half of every round, at rest in the second.

With `text/7`: from `pose` to rest once, swinging past rest and back several times, less
each time, like something on a spring.

With `text/7`: from `pose` to rest once, falling faster and faster, then bouncing back
towards `pose` three times, less each time, like a dropped ball.

CharMotion.description:
One way a text's characters move one after another (`text/5`). Characters are counted from
the start of the text, white space left out.

pose.description: Where a character is when it is furthest from rest.

progress.description:
How far along the movement is. For `settle` and `spring`: 0, no character has started, to
1, every character is in place. For `wave` and `hop`: rounds, 1 a whole round.

reverse.description: Counted from the last character instead of the first.

step.description:
How much later each character starts than the one before. For `settle` and `spring`, in
units of one character's own time: 0 moves them all together, 1 starts each as the one
before arrives. For `wave` and `hop`, in rounds.

unit.description: With `text/7`: what moves as one, about its own centre, where this says "character".

CharPose.description: Where a character is, against where the layout puts it.

opacity.description: How much of it shows, 0 to 1.

rotation.description: Turned about its own centre, degrees clockwise.

Color.description: A straight (not premultiplied) sRGB colour with alpha, each 0 to 1.

Comp.description:
A composition: an edit inside the edit (a compound clip's timeline). Its picture is as large
as the output and see-through where no layer draws; its time starts at 0.

Crop.description:
Edges cut off a picture, as fractions of its width (`left`, `right`) and height (`top`,
`bottom`); what is left must be at least 1 % of each.

CropKeys.description:
A crop that changes: each edge as in [`Crop`], keyed. A renderer keeps at least 1 % of the
picture, shrinking a pair of opposite edges in proportion where their keys would cut more.

Ease.description: Interpolation from one key to the next.

oneOf.description: Straight line.
Hold this value until the next key.
Smoothstep: slow out of this key and into the next.

Effect.description: An effect applied to a layer.

asset.description: An asset the effect reads: the `lut` of `color.lut@1`.

EngineRequirements.description: What a renderer must provide to draw this spec.

features.description: Feature ids the spec uses beyond the base format, such as `text/1`.

min.description: The oldest renderer version that draws this spec correctly (semver), if any.

Fit.description: How media is fitted to the output frame.

oneOf.description: Whole picture visible, bars where the shapes differ.
Frame covered, picture cropped where the shapes differ.
Stretched to the frame.

FrameRate.description: A rational frame rate, `num / den` frames per second (30000 / 1001 is 29.97).

ease.description: How the value moves from this key to the next.

t.description: Time relative to the owner's start.

ease.description: How the value moves from this key to the next.

t.description: Time relative to the owner's start.

at.description: When the layer starts on the output timeline.

blend.description: How it combines with what is below.

crop.description: Edges cut off a media layer's picture before it is fitted (feature `crop/1`).

crop_keys.description: The crop over the layer's time, in place of `crop` (feature `crop/2`).

flip_x.description: A media layer's picture mirrored left to right (feature `flip/1`).

flip_y.description: A media layer's picture mirrored top to bottom (feature `flip/1`).

fx.description: Effects, applied in order to the layer's own picture before it is placed.

id.description: Id, unique in the spec; the editor uses its clip id so a render maps back to the edit.

mask.description: A `mask_sequence` asset whose alpha multiplies this layer.

parent.description:
The layer that carries this one, among the layers it is listed with (feature
`layer.parent/1`). This layer is placed as it would be alone, and then moved, scaled and
turned as the parent's transform moves the frame: its `position` is counted from the
parent's (a layer at the centre sits on the parent's anchor), along the parent's own
turned and scaled axes. A parent at the centre, at scale 1 and unturned changes nothing.
The parent's transform is taken at the same output instant on the parent's own clock,
held at its first value before the parent starts and at its last after it ends, so the
parent need not be on screen; nothing else of the parent (its opacity, crop, effects) is
passed on. A parent may have a parent, eight deep.

shape_mask.description: A shape that shows part of the layer, in the layer's own picture (feature `mask.shape/1`).

shape_mask_keys.description:
Where and how big `shape_mask` is over the layer's time, in place of its own centre, size,
rotation and feather (feature `mask.shape/2`).

transform.description: Where it sits. Keyframe times are relative to the layer's start.

oneOf.description: Frames of a video or image asset.

between.description:
What shows when an output instant falls between two frames of a video: what a clip
slowed down, or a file of fewer frames a second than the output, is made smooth with.
A still ignores it.

fit.description: How the picture is fitted to the frame before the transform applies.

time.description: Which source instant each output instant shows.

oneOf.description: A flat colour filling the frame.
Set text (feature `text/1`).

align.description: Alignment of the lines within the block.

chars.description:
With `text/5`: the characters move one after another, each about its own centre, from where
the layout puts them. Several movements add up. Boxes and underlines stay where they are.

draw.description:
With `text/7`: the text is written on, each character's outline drawn by a pen before its
fill comes in.

font.description:
A `font` asset; absent means the renderer's bundled default face (Noto Sans SC, which also
covers Latin). Characters the face lacks fall back to the other faces the renderer has.

gradient.description: With `text/2`: the fill fades from `color` at the block's top to this at its bottom.

highlight.description: With `text/7`: part of the text takes another colour as it is said (karaoke).

italic.description: With `text/4`: slanted; the face's own italic when it has one, otherwise sheared.

leading.description: With `text/4`: space added between lines, in ems (negative: closer together).

number.description:
With `text/6`: a number that changes over time (a price, a count, a clock), written into
`text` where it says `{n}`, or as the whole text when it does not.

outer.description: With `text/2`: a second outline, outside `stroke` (its width counts from `stroke`'s edge).

reveal.description:
With `text/3`: how much of the text shows, 0 to 1, counted in characters from the start
(a typewriter). The lines stay where the whole text puts them; a box behind each line
grows with what shows of it.

shadow.description: With `text/2`: a soft shadow of the glyphs and their outlines, beneath them.

size.description: Size of the em in output pixels.

stroke.description: An outline around the glyphs, drawn beneath the fill.

tracking.description: With `text/4`: space added after every character, in ems (negative: closer together).

underline.description: With `text/4`: a line under each line of text, outlined and shadowed with the glyphs.

width.description: Wrap width in output pixels; absent, lines break only at `\n`.

oneOf.description:
A drawn shape (feature `shape/1`): a box, ellipse, line, polygon, star, price tag or
arrow, filled and outlined, its outline drawn on over time. Its centre is placed by the
layer's transform; its size is in output pixels, before the layer's scale.

fill.description: What fills it; none leaves only the outline.

fill_opacity.description: How much of the fill shows, 0 to 1 (1 when absent).

inner.description: How far in a star's inner corners are, 0.05 to 1 of the way to its points.

points.description: Sides of a polygon, points of a star: 3 to 64.

radius.description: Corner radius of a rectangle or a tag.

shadow.description: A soft shadow of the fill and outline, beneath them.

size.description: Width and height of its box.

stroke.description: The outline, centred on the shape's edge (a line's only ink).

trim.description:
The part of the outline drawn, as fractions of its length from its start: an outline that
draws itself on (its end rising from 0 to 1) or a stroke that runs round it.

oneOf.description:
The picture of a composition (feature `comp/1`): drawn first, on a see-through frame the
size of the output, then placed, cropped, masked and given this layer's effects as one
picture.

from.description: The composition's instant shown at the layer's start; it runs at speed 1 from there.

oneOf.description: Everything above a line through the centre (turned by `rotation`).
A band through the centre.
An ellipse.
A rectangle.

NumberText.description: A number shown by a text (`text/6`).

clock.description: Written as a clock of whole seconds: `m:ss`, or `h:mm:ss` from an hour.

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point, 0 to 4.

value.description: The value over the layer's time.

audio.description: How to encode the sound; absent for a silent output.

background.description: Colour under every layer (straight sRGB, 0 to 1).

format.description: The kind of file to write.

height.description: Height in pixels; even, at most 8192.

video.description: How to encode the picture; absent when only frames are wanted.

width.description: Width in pixels; even, at most 8192.

OutputFormat.description: The kind of file an output is written as.

oneOf.description: The picture and the sound, in an MP4.

The picture alone as an animated GIF that plays round and round (feature `encode.gif/1`),
at `video.size` when one is given; a frame lasts `1 ÷ fps`, to the hundredth of a second.
The sound alone, encoded as `audio` says, in an M4A (feature `encode.audio/1`).

The sound alone as 16-bit PCM in a WAV, at `audio`'s sample rate (feature
`encode.audio/1`).
One colour.
From one colour to another along a line across the box.

angle.description: Which way the line runs, degrees clockwise from left-to-right (90: top to bottom).

from.description: The colour where the line starts.

oneOf.description: From one colour at the box's centre to another at its edge.

to.description: The colour at the edge (and beyond, in the corners).

oneOf.description: A box, its corners rounded by `radius`.
An ellipse filling the box.
A line across the middle of the box, left to right; it shows by its stroke.
A regular polygon of `points` sides, a corner at the top, stretched to the box.
A star of `points` points, stretched to the box: a burst badge with many.
A price tag: a box pointed at its left end, with a hole near the point.
An arrow pointing right.

ShapeMask.description:
A shape that shows part of a layer.

It is placed in the layer's own picture (after any crop), so it moves, turns and scales with
the layer. Lengths are in units of the picture's shorter side, so a circle stays round.

center.description: Its centre, as fractions of the picture's width and height (0.5, 0.5 is the middle).

feather.description: Width of the soft edge, 0 for a hard one.

size.description: Width and height (for `mirror`, the height is the band's thickness; `linear` ignores it).

ShapeMaskKeys.description: A shape mask that moves: the values of [`ShapeMask`] that can, keyed.

offset.description: Offset `[right, down]`, on the frame (it does not turn with the shape).

SpeedKey.description: One point of a speed ramp.

TextAlign.description: How lines line up within a text block.

oneOf.description: Left edges line up.
Centred.
Right edges line up.

lines.description: With `text/3`: a box behind each line, hugging it, instead of one behind the block.

padding.description: Space between the text and the box edge, in ems.

progress.description:
0, nothing shows, to 1, the text as it is. In between the characters are written one
after another: a pen follows each one's outline, then its fill, outlines and shadow fade
in and the pen's line goes.

step.description:
How much later each character starts than the one before, in units of one character's
own time: 0 writes them all together, 1 starts each as the one before is done.

width.description:
The pen's width in ems. It draws in the colour of the text's outline, or of its fill when
it has none.

TextHighlight.description: Part of a text in another colour as it is said (`text/7`).

color.description: The fill of what is highlighted, in place of the text's own colour or gradient.

progress.description:
How much of the text has been said: 0, none of it, to 1, all of it, counted in characters,
white space left out.

unit.description:
`char`: everything said so far, the edge passing smoothly through the character being
said. `word` and `line`: the word or line being said, alone; none before 0 or from 1 on.

blur.description: Softness: the blur's standard deviation, in ems.

offset.description: Offset `[right, down]` in ems, on the frame (it does not turn with the text).

width.description: Width outside the glyph edge, in output pixels.

TextUnit.description: What of a text moves as one, or is said as one (`text/7`).

oneOf.description: Each character.

Each word: characters with no white space between them. A Chinese character or a kana is
a word of its own, together with the punctuation that follows it.
Each line, as the text is laid out.

Tick.description: A position or a duration in ticks.

TimeMap.description:
Source time for a media layer or audio clip: `source = source_in + ∫ speed dt` from the owner's
start. With no `ramp` the speed is constant, so `source = source_in + (t - at) * speed`.

ramp.description:
A speed that changes over time (feature `time.ramp/1`): straight lines between keys, held
before the first and after the last. Key times are from the owner's start.

source_in.description: Source instant shown at the owner's start.

speed.description:
Playback speed, -100 to 100. 0 holds `source_in` (a freeze frame, feature `time.hold/1`);
below 0 plays backwards (feature `time.reverse/1`). Ignored when `ramp` is given.

Transform.description: A layer's placement, about the frame's centre.

anchor.description:
The point of the layer's picture that sits at `position`, and that the layer is scaled and
turned about: fractions of the picture as it shows (after any crop) from its top left.
Its centre, `[0.5, 0.5]`, when absent (feature `transform.anchor/1`).

position.description:
Offset of the layer's centre from the frame's centre, as fractions of the frame (x right,
y down).

scale.description: Uniform scale; 1 is the fitted size.

stretch.description:
Width and height scaled apart, `[across, down]`, on top of `scale` (feature
`transform.stretch/1`).

turn.description: The layer turned in space, seen in perspective (feature `transform.3d/1`).

Trim.description: The part of an outline that is drawn.

end.description: Where it ends, 0 to 1; nothing is drawn where it is not past `start`.

start.description: Where the drawn part starts, 0 to 1.

Turn.description:
A layer turned out of the frame's plane about its anchor, after its `rotation` in the plane
is undone and before it is done again: first about the horizontal axis, then the vertical.
It is seen from straight in front of where its anchor is, so a layer turned on its own closes
like a door or a lid evenly, wherever in the frame it is. A layer carried by another
([`Layer::parent`]) that is turned is seen from where the outermost turned layer carrying it
is, so the two stay one object. Past 90 degrees a layer shows its back, mirrored.

distance.description: How far the eye is, in frame heights: nearer is a stronger perspective. Positive.

x.description: Degrees about the horizontal axis: positive tips the top edge away.

y.description: Degrees about the vertical axis: positive swings the right edge away.

oneOf.description: H.264 / AVC.
H.265 / HEVC.
AV1.

bitrate_kbps.description:
Target bitrate in kbit/s: used when no `crf` is given, or by encoders without a
constant-quality mode (hardware ones).

crf.description: Constant quality (lower is better), when the encoder supports it.

size.description:
Encode at this size instead of the output's (feature `encode.size/1`): the frame is drawn
`width ÷ output.width` times the output size. Both even, and the height must be
`round(output.height × width ÷ output.width)`, so the picture is not stretched.

description: A finished edit, ready to render.

assets.description: Every file the edit reads, by id. Ids are local to this spec.

comps.description:
Compositions by id (feature `comp/1`): each a picture and a sound made of layers and
audio clips of its own, shown by [`LayerContent::Comp`] layers and played by audio clips
that name it. Ids are local to this spec.

output.description: The picture and sound to produce.
